subject.title: Skill install codeblock UI should be org scoped

question: Should a maintainer close this collaborator-authored issue now that main and production tags implement the requested owner-scoped skill install code block?
rationale: The code evidence satisfies the central request, but the cleanup policy protects collaborator-authored issues from automatic closure without explicit maintainer judgment.

options.title: Close as implemented

options.title: Keep for broader CLI follow-up
options.body: Leave it open only if the intended scope is broader than the ClawHub skill-detail code block and still needs a separate OpenClaw CLI compatibility decision.
